why: B: on every abstract connected complete Riemannian ℝⁿ-manifold (any smooth metric, any Levi-Civita connection), for Milnor's data (Setup16: ε as in Lemma 10.8 on S, tᵢ₊₁−tᵢ < ε²/c), there EXIST r and r_u : Ω → Ω with all of Milnor's listed properties (r(Int Ω^c) ⊆ B, r|B = id, the pieces of r(ω) and r_u(ω) are the short geodesics, E(rω) ≤ Eω, r_0 = id, r_1 = r, joint continuity in the d-topology). A (universe 0; retr, deform are vocabulary): for slice submanifolds N ⊆ V and a Morse.BrokenSetup, the project's specific retr satisfies E(r_u γ) ≤ E(γ), fixes broken geodesics on [0,1], and deform is jointly continuous on [0,1] × Int Ω^c. A ⇒ B fails genuinely (abstract manifolds; and r(ω) ∈ B, r_0 = id, r_1 = r are not among A's theorems). B ⇒ A fails genuinely: B is existential and says nothing about the project's retr/deform.
embedded_special_case_note: Items/V10_7.lean: B_emb := B for M = Bridge.Sub hN, cov = Bridge.conn (B_to_B_emb via conn_isLC). Not proved: A ⇒ B_emb needs new geometry, not dictionary glue — B's Setup16 does not yield a Morse.BrokenSetup with δ = ε: the project also requires δ ≤ a normal radius at every point of S (BrokenSetup.normal), IsShortJoin (Cor. 10.8 with minimality and a smooth local representative on an OPEN set of V×V) and compact S; the normal-radius condition does not follow from ShortGood (unit sphere, small cap S, ShortGood S ε holds for some ε > π), and shrinking δ may break c·(tᵢ₊₁−tᵢ) < δ² for B's subdivision. Even for BrokenSetup data the transport would need dictionaries absent from the Bridge: blind Ω (functions ℝ → ↥N, topology generated by d-balls) ↔ Morse.PathSp (Items/V10_1.lean Emb.edist_eq gives d = edist), blind B (geodesic on closed [tᵢ,tᵢ₊₁]) ↔ BrokenSetup.brokenPaths (IsGeodesicOn on open pieces + piecewise smooth), ℕ-indexed t ↔ Fin-indexed Subdivision.t, JoinsShort ↔ the project's sgeoOver. B_emb ⇒ A is impossible in content (A is about a specific construction).
